task_summary: Estimate an investment spending shock to Georgia's economy using demand-side macro accounting in Excel, collecting IMF WEO and GeoStat SUT data, computing import content share, and modeling 3 scenarios with bell-shaped spending allocation.
decomposition_rationale: This task has three distinct functional domains: (1) data ingestion and population from pre-downloaded IMF WEO and GeoStat SUT sources into Excel sheets, (2) computing the import content share from Supply and Use Tables, and (3) building the demand-side National Accounts shock model with scenario analysis. These map cleanly to the three steps in the task instruction and have clear data flow dependencies.

skills.name: evo-macro-weo-data
skills.description: Populates the WEO_Data sheet in the Excel workbook with IMF World Economic Outlook data for Georgia, and extends projections (real GDP growth held constant from 2027-2043, GDP deflator extended using 4-year average growth rate). Also copies GeoStat Supply and Use Table sheets into the workbook.
skills.responsibility: Reading pre-downloaded IMF WEO data files and GeoStat SUT files from /root/data/, populating the WEO_Data sheet with the correct WEO subject codes (NGDP, NGDPD, NGDP_R, NGDP_D, NGDP_RPCH, PCPIPCH), extending GDP deflator and real GDP projections to 2043 using Excel formulas, and copying the 38x38 SUPPLY and USE sheets into the workbook.
dr_sections: IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO) Database Structure and Data Extraction
Required Variables and Exact Subject Codes
Mathematical Projections: GDP Deflator and Real GDP
GeoStat's SUT Classification and Base Year
Openpyxl Implementation Patterns for Excel Manipulation

skills.name: evo-macro-sut-import-share
skills.description: Links Supply and Use Table data to the SUT Calc sheet, computes product-level import shares using the proportionality assumption, and calculates the estimated import content share of investment (cell C46).
skills.responsibility: Populating columns C-H of the SUT Calc sheet by linking data from the copied SUPPLY and USE sheets, computing import-to-supply ratios per product, applying them to GFCF column, and deriving the aggregate import content share theta using Excel formulas.
dr_sections: Supply and Use Table (SUT) Methodology for Import Content Estimation
The Structure of the SUT and "Column C-H"

skills.name: evo-macro-demand-shock-scenarios
skills.description: Builds the National Accounts (NA) sheet with the full demand-side investment shock model including bell-shaped spending allocation, currency conversion, deflation, import leakage adjustment, and multiplier application. Creates 3 scenario tables with different parameters.
skills.responsibility: Linking WEO baseline data to NA sheet columns C and J, setting assumptions (exchange rate 2.746, demand multiplier 0.8, bell-shape allocation percentages), implementing the full formula chain (USD allocation → GEL conversion → real deflation → import adjustment → multiplier → GDP impact %), and replicating the structure for Scenario 2 (multiplier=1.0) and Scenario 3 (import share=0.5).
dr_sections: Demand-Side Macro Accounting Framework for Investment Shock Analysis
The Demand Multiplier in a Small Open Economy
Scenario Analysis Structure and Presentation of Results
Headless Recalculation of Excel Formulas Using LibreOffice on Ubuntu
